message: No detected input validation: User-supplied form inputs are concatenated directly into SQL queries without any type, structure, or range validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched from a GCP bucket and SQL database without any checksum verification, signature validation, or source authentication beyond basic credentials.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed anywhere in the data preparation flow.
No detected model integrity verification: The pkl_read function loads a pickle file directly with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before deserializing the model.

No detected label distribution validation: The training code in model.py reads CSV data and trains directly without any class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used in any part of the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: User input from request.form is passed directly into SQL queries via string concatenation and to the model without any shape, type, range, or schema validation.
No detected output bounds checks: There is no code visible that checks model prediction outputs for NaN, out-of-range probabilities, or unexpected values before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a classical ML classifier (NB, SVM, etc.), not an LLM, so prompt injection is not directly applicable, and no such defenses are implemented.
